messages:
maria: Morning — async standup. Quick update:

- What I did: landed a small change to the kernel slot allocator (reduces slot contention p95 ~12% on our local bench).
- Blockers: still seeing short-lived KV eviction spikes during microburst tests, seems correlated with a tiny hotkey set.
- Today: running a targeted microburst sweep (seq_len=256/1024), will open a PR for a small batcher tweak and a config change for eviction threshold. ping @sam for review. :rocket:

sam: Nice work! Which bench did you run for the 12%? can you paste the exact command so I can reproduce?

maria: Sure — using our kbench wrapper.

```
./kbench run --model=resnet-lm --seq_len=256 --concurrency=80 --duration=120 --label=slot-allocator-fix
```

sam: thanks. i'll take a pass after the maintenance window. can you also run seq_len=1024? we need tail latency numbers.

ashok: For the eviction spikes — did you check hotkey distribution vs shard affinity? i noticed shard-3 had ~3x hotkey qps yesterday. i can run a quick heatmap if you want.

maria: running heatmap now, preliminary shows hotkey set ~0.6% of keys but accounts for ~22% of lookups on shard-3. bumping eviction threshold from 0.5 -> 0.6 reduced immediate churn in a quick local test. i'll include the numbers in the PR.

ci-bot: CI: build passed for commit abc123 on branch feature/slot-allocator-fix (tests: unit/integration/bench-smoke). :white_check_mark:

olivia: FYI perf cluster will be down for network maintenance today 14:00-15:00 UTC. plan bench runs accordingly.

sam: ok i'll schedule the heavy seq_len=1024 runs for 15:15 UTC then. @maria leave a note in the PR so i get a review ping after 15:00.

kai: Heads-up — if you change eviction thresholds we should gate the Dedicated canary config too. small threshold changes can affect memory pressure for reserved pools. suggest canary rollout and a quick mem/test-run.

maria: good call. i'll add rollout plan in PR: canary 5% for 1h, monitor token p99, evict-rate, and mem used. will ping @eng-sre to watch oncall.

ashok: I have microburst traces saved at /tmp/microburst-2026-03-18.tar.gz if anyone wants raw traces.

maria: perfect, thanks. i'll attach the relevant slices to the bench results in the repo (linking to the artifacts). will update here when PR is up. :memo:
